Save your callers as contacts first
Save your callers as contacts first Your assistant recognises callers the same way your phone does — by the name your phone shows.
So the most useful thing you can do before switching this on is to save your authorised numbers as contacts on the phone you connected.
If a number is not saved as a contact, your phone shows the number instead — so put the number on the list.
Nothing prompts you to do it, and a list of names against a phone with no contacts saved will turn away callers you meant to let through.
Northside will match a contact saved as Northside depot, so you do not have to reproduce your contact names exactly.
Turn it on once your list is complete and your contacts are saved — not before, or your own test calls will be the first thing it turns away.
